Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedures P1, 
 which must be carried out 
 every two years as indicated by Y2 in the 
 title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Hanan Elbadrawy, revised by eng Ayman Ayyad, tested by eng Fahmy 
Abd El Khalek, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd EL-Qader El Nagar, 
accepted by general director eng Fawzy Elzemety, and approved by eng. Awad Fathy 
Head Sector of Talkha PS
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed 
 Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general director 
 and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear the personal protective equipment must used as 
 safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
CT must be out of service and isolated from the network
Tools and Equipment
X1, X2 two cables of secondary.
Tester CTER-91 as shown in the figure.
Power supply
Voltage range switch
H1, H2 two cable of primary.

Set-up control before testing 
 regard to figure1 and the

Caution:
For operator and equipment safety, make sure current 
 transformers are de-energized before any testing is started.
Saturation Test Procedures
Refer to the 
 figure of test connections
Verify that the 
 power ON/OFF switch is OFF. connect the test set to a suitable source of power 
 (as indicated on the nameplate) and ground.
Connect the test 
 set secondary out put binding posts X1 and X2 to secondary of current 
 transformer X1 and X2.observe polarity marks on the CT( X1 on the CTER-91 is 
 polarity).
Connect the test 
 set primary binding posts H1 and H2 to CT primary bushings H1 and H2 observe 
 polarity marks (H1 on the CTER-91 is polarity).
Turn power ON/OFF 
 switch to ON
Slowly increase 
 OUT PUT control observing ammeter and secondary voltmeter. When a very small 
 increase in voltage causes a large increase in current, the CT has reached the 
 saturation point (usually less than one amp)
Switch the RUN / 
 HOLD switch to HOLD. Return output control to zero read record the saturation 
 amperes and voltage
Return RUN/ 
 HOLD switch to run .
